summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Corporación América Airports S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains standard quarterly financial results, including revenue, operating income, and earnings per share, with no mention of any special situation such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews. No securities offering, material definitive agreement, or corporate event triggering a special-situation classification is disclosed. The filing is purely an interim financial update required under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
